text:
To resolve the `Permission denied` error on `/opt/data/config.yaml` when deploying via Docker on UGOS Pro (or other NAS hosts with bind mounts), you need to pass user/group ID environment variables matching your host permissions.

### Solution
Pass the **`PUID`** and **`PGID`** (or **`HERMES_UID`** and **`HERMES_GID`**) environment variables to your Docker container.

For example, when running the container:
```bash
docker run -it \
  -e PUID=$(id -u) \
  -e PGID=$(id -g) \
  -v /path/to/host/data:/opt/data \
  nousresearch/hermes-agent:latest
```
*(Or use `-e HERMES_UID=<uid> -e HERMES_GID=<gid>`)*

This aligns container filesystem operations with your host's user and group permissions, preventing `[Errno 13] Permission denied` errors during configuration writes and reloads.
